active_storylines.storyline_label: Anthropic Claude containment architecture published (gVisor + Seatbelt/Bubblewrap + per-OS VMs)
active_storylines.last_state_change_summary: Anthropic engineering blog published 'How we contain Claude across products' walking through the three-tier reference design: gVisor + seccomp on isolated infra for Claude.ai (ephemeral per-session FS), OS-native sandboxes for Claude Code (Seatbelt macOS, Bubblewrap Linux, 84% permission-prompt reduction via model-classifier delegation), guest VMs for Claude Cowork on Apple Virtualization Framework macOS + HCS Windows with host-held credentials + read-only/read-write/read-write-no-delete file mount modes. Argument: 'the software you build yourself is often the weakest' — mature hypervisors and container runtimes outperform custom security wrappers. Simon Willison amplified Saturday evening and demonstrated by getting Opus 4.8 (Claude Code for web) to refactor Datasette Lite from Web Workers to service workers — Python ASGI server-side in browser via Pyodide + working FastCGI demo + Datasette 1.0a31.
